home.profile.clearsLateBody: {papers, plural, one {# paper was} other {# papers were}} added late. This is the one figure worth reading first: a paper remembered after you have started is a paper you could not have had ready, and that is how goods end up sitting at a port. It says nothing about honesty or care — the difference between a good clearance and a bad one is usually knowing the list up front.

home.landing.faq1q: Do I need an address to send a parcel?
home.landing.faq1a: No. You send it to a shop, and the person you send it to collects it from a shop. You pick both shops when you book.
home.landing.faq2a: You see the price before you send, with no account. It depends on the size of the parcel and the distance, and you pay at the counter.
home.landing.faq3a: It depends on the distance between the two shops. The tracking page shows every step on the way, and the SeeBuyGet front page shows how long parcels take today.
home.landing.faq4q: How does the receiver collect it?
home.landing.faq4a: The parcel and its collection code are in the Send app, on the phone number it was sent to — SeeBuyGet sends no text about a parcel. At the shop the receiver shows the code and the shop hands the parcel over. Nobody without the code can collect it.
home.landing.faq5a: The shop keeps it for a set number of days, and the receiver is reminded in the Send app. After that it is sent back or kept for a fee, and the receiver is told before that happens.
home.landing.faq6a: Yes. Type its tracking code in the box at the top of the SeeBuyGet front page, or open the parcel in the Send app.
home.landing.faq7q: How do I earn with SeeBuyGet?
home.landing.faq7a: Where a SeeBuyGet company runs in the country, shops earn a fee on every parcel they take in or hand out, drivers and riders earn per load they carry, and sort hubs earn on every parcel they sort. Where SeeBuyGet only matches, you agree the price with whoever you carry for and settle it with them directly. Joining takes a few minutes.
home.landing.faq9q: What does a shop need to sign up?
home.landing.faq9a: A phone with Android 10 or newer, power all day, a trading licence and the owner’s national ID. Signing up takes a few minutes; the shop takes parcels once SeeBuyGet has checked its papers.
home.landing.faq11q: Can the shop open my parcel?
home.landing.faq11a: A SeeBuyGet parcel is photographed when the shop takes it in and when it is handed out, and it travels between shops in closed bags — on a coded seal, or photographed closed. A seal that is not as written is held and reported before anything moves on.
home.landing.faq10q: Can my online store send to SeeBuyGet shops?
home.landing.faq10a: Yes. A store signs up on this site and ships each order to the shop its buyer picks: labels from the Store app, or from its own system through the shipping API. The buyer collects with a code, so the store needs no couriers of its own.
home.landing.faq8a: Shops and drivers are ID-checked, parcels are photographed at both ends, and only the receiver’s code releases a parcel.
home.welcome.spoken: Welcome to SeeBuyGet. Send a parcel, track one, or sign up as a shop, a driver, a sort hub, an online store or a fleet office.
home.roles.title: What are you?
home.roles.lede: Pick the one that fits. You can sign up in a few minutes.
home.signin.title: Open your app
home.signin.lede: Pick the one you work with.
home.signin.business: A business: shippers, importers and expeditors
home.signin.businessSub: Your team, each with their own phone and PIN — also clearing agents and container yards
home.signin.partner: A partner company: a local courier carrying for the network
home.signin.partnerSub: Its own people, each with their own phone and PIN, see what it owes, live
home.signin.noAccount: No account to price or track — sign in to book
home.signin.aloud: Pick the app you work with: shop, driver, sort hub, online store, or fleet office.
home.join.ready.title: Have ready
home.join.ready.pudo: Your ID number, the shop’s trading licence number and its opening hours — and an email address and a password for the shop’s account: the Shop app signs in with them.
home.join.ready.mdp: An email address and a password for the hub’s account — the Hub app signs in with them — where the hub is, how many bags its floor holds at once and how many parcels it sorts in a day.
home.join.ready.vendor: An email address and a password for the store’s account: the Store app signs in with them.
home.join.ready.driver: Your ID number. On a motorcycle or anything larger, your driving licence too — its number, its expiry date and a photo of it — and a photo of your ID card. The Driver app opens with this phone number and a PIN you choose.
home.join.ready.fleet: The company’s registration, operator’s licence and tax numbers, and a photo of four papers: the certificate of registration, the operator’s licence, the owner’s ID and a proof of address. The Fleet app opens with this phone number and a PIN you choose.

home.join.spoken.code: Type the code we just sent to your phone.
home.join.spoken.where: Tap the map to show where you are. No street address needed.
home.join.spoken.login: Last step. Pick an email and a password to sign in with.
home.join.spoken.pin: Choose a five-digit PIN. You open your app with your phone number and this PIN.
home.join.spoken.papers: Take a photograph of each of the four papers.
home.join.spoken.shopPapers: Take a photo of your ID and of the trading licence, or choose them from the phone as a photo or a PDF, and a photo of the shop. Or skip for now: the shop waits until they are sent.

home.block.licenceExpiry: Say when your licence runs out.

home.block.truckSubtype: Say what kind of truck it is.
home.block.location: Tap the map to drop a pin where you are.
home.block.country: Pick the country you are signing up in.
home.block.shopPapers: Add your ID, the trading licence and a photo of the shop — or skip for now.
home.block.address: Give the shop’s address: every part it asks for.
home.block.email: Type an email you can open.
home.block.recoveryEmail: Type your email, send yourself the code, and type the code.
home.block.nameFleet: Type the company’s name, as it is registered.
home.block.operatorLicence: Type the number of its transport operator’s licence.
